verdict.rationale: Whether invoicing software publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this product category, since open-source invoicing tools exist. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Zoho Invoice's source is available under any open license. The pack covers only hosted SaaS features, an llms.txt file, and failed OpenAPI and markdown-docs probes, none of which concern source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
